advancements.faunaandorchestra.full_orch: Arrange your very own Orchestra for the first time!
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust0: Nice to meet you! I'm Faust, and together we're The Ringtails
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust1: Nice to see you again, %! Care to join us?
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust1s: Hey dude! How is it going? Say hi to an old friend!
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust2: Hey, %. Try not to scare us next time, alright?
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust3: I've played the accordion since I was a child. The odd one out!
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust4: You're free to tip us some gold if you want!
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust5: I've got a couple items that might come in handy to you, pal
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust6: Orion and I have been playing together for 30 years!
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust7: Time goes by so fast, don't ever forget that
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust8: I might lend you some liquid music for some gold if you want
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust9: Music is the core of life, we just live around it
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust10: The Ringtails is our past and future! Long live folklore music!
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust11: Don't you love the little things in life?
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust12: I think Orion would rock an eye patch, but he likes it that way
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust13: We get along with the Jazzy Dammys, do you know them?
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust14: Haven't had a haircut in 17 years and counting!
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust15: You're kind of weird, you know? What species are you?
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust16: How did we meet? We don't know each other very well
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust17: The Great Composer? Uhm... Never heard of him
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust18: Why do we keep playing music? Kind of a long story
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust19: Why do we talk? Hmm... Kind of private, don't you think?
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust16s: We were both kicked out of our families, so we formed our own
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust17s: Tiego is the Great Composer. He's done unforgivable things...
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust18s: We hope that she might listen to our music and come back...
dialogue.faunaandorchestra.faust19s: Sentience comes from Nature's touch. Nothing more I can say.
